name: ICD-10-CM
description: International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modification. FY27 content is derived from CMS/NCHS Tabular XML and the companion full order file. The root, chapters, sections, concrete diagnosis codes, parent hierarchy, order number, valid-for-submission flag, leaf status, Tabular instructional notes (excludes1, excludes2, useAdditionalCode, codeFirst, codeAlso, notes) and seventh-character instructions are modeled from those official files. The legacy staging source carried UMLS enrichments (CUI and Semantic Types) that CMS/NCHS does not supply; they are not carried (temporary policy, pending a documented decision).
copyright: Developed by the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. U.S. government works are not subject to copyright protection within the United States. ICD-10-CM is based on the WHO International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision; WHO authorized NCHS to develop the U.S. clinical modification.

properties.description: OCL class projected from the official FY27 XML role: Root for the synthetic root, Chapter for chapter ranges, Section for section ranges, and Diagnosis for XML diag nodes and concrete seventh-character extensions.

The five-digit, 1-based record sequence in the complete CMS/NCHS FY27 order file. It is a release-local ordering aid, not the ICD-10-CM code or a clinical identifier; it can change whenever a release inserts, removes, or reorders codes.
CMS/NCHS order-file flag: true when the concrete code is valid for submission in the stated fiscal-year release.
Derived from the FY27 hierarchy; false when the concept has a child chapter, a nested structural section, an explicit diagnosis, or a seventh-character extension code.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List <excludes1> instructional note(s), regenerated from the FY27 Tabular XML for every applicable concept; one list item per <note>, in document order. Excludes1: the excluded condition is mutually exclusive with this concept and is not coded together with it.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List <excludes2> instructional note(s), regenerated from the FY27 Tabular XML for every applicable concept; one list item per <note>, in document order. Excludes2: the excluded condition is not part of this concept, but both conditions may be present and coded together.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List <useAdditionalCode> instructional note(s), regenerated from the FY27 Tabular XML for every applicable concept; one list item per <note>, in document order. Use additional code: an additional code is needed to give a complete picture of the condition.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List <codeFirst> instructional note(s), regenerated from the FY27 Tabular XML for every applicable concept; one list item per <note>, in document order. Code first: the underlying condition is sequenced before this concept.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List <codeAlso> instructional note(s), regenerated from the FY27 Tabular XML for every applicable concept; one list item per <note>, in document order. Code also: two codes may be required to describe the condition; their sequencing depends on the circumstances.

ICD-10-CM Tabular List <notes> instructional note(s), regenerated from the FY27 Tabular XML for every applicable concept; one list item per <note>, in document order. General instructional notes of the chapter, section or code.

filters.description: Focuses the list on leaf concepts.
